rules.label: storefront browse read
rules.description: Anonymous visitors must be able to browse the storefront; a signed-in caller is still resolved so per-user scope keeps working.

rules.label: recharge catalogue read
rules.description: Recharge packages/plans/settings are public today and need no credential.

rules.label: preserve already-anonymous surface
rules.description: A non-browse operation that is already published anonymous (webhooks, cashier links, display config) is not proposed for a login gate by this audit.

rules.label: default: login required
rules.description: Every other operation is user-scoped or state-changing and requires a login.
